info.name: ECOFlow API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the ECOFlow Engineering Change Order system (backend: Express + Prisma + PostgreSQL).

Base URLs:
• Local: http://localhost:5000/api
• Production (Render): https://ecoflow-backend.onrender.com/api

1. Run `POST /auth/signup` then `POST /auth/login` — accessToken is saved automatically.
2. Requests needing an id (productId, bomId, ecoId, userId, stageId…) use collection variables: copy the id from a GET response into the variable, or set them via a test script.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Signup, login, token refresh, profile & password management.

request.description: Register a new user. New users start in PENDING status until an ADMIN approves them.
Authenticate and receive accessToken + refreshToken (auto-saved to collection variables).
Exchange a valid refresh token for a new access token.
Current authenticated user profile with roles.
Update profile. multipart/form-data — avatar is optional.

item.name: Users
item.description: Admin user management: list, update, status, password reset, delete.

request.description: ACTIVE / SUSPENDED — suspending forces logout on next request.

item.name: Roles
item.description: Assign / add / remove roles (ENGINEERING, APPROVER, OPERATIONS, ADMIN).

item.name: Products
item.description: Product master data and version history.

item.name: BOMs
item.description: Bill of Materials: versions, components and operations.

item.name: ECOs
item.description: Engineering Change Orders: full lifecycle DRAFT → IN_REVIEW → APPROVED → APPLIED.

request.description: type: COMPONENT_CHANGE | OPERATION_CHANGE | GENERAL. versionUpdate: MINOR | MAJOR.
APPROVER/ADMIN. approved=true moves to the next approval stage; fullApproval=true approves all stages at once.
ADMIN only — applies approved changes to the live BOM/product version.

item.name: ECO Draft Components
item.description: Draft component lines inside an ECO (ADD / UPDATE / DELETE).

item.name: ECO Draft Operations
item.description: Draft operation lines inside an ECO (ADD / UPDATE / DELETE).

item.name: Attachments
item.description: File uploads (multipart/form-data, field name: file) stored on Cloudinary.

request.description: ENGINEERING/ADMIN. Send multipart form-data with a file field.

item.name: Reports
item.description: Audit logs, ECO statistics, version history, archived products.

item.name: Comparison
item.description: Diff ECO changes and compare BOM versions.

request.description: Before/after diff of the ECO’s draft vs the live BOM.

item.name: Operations
item.description: Read-only views for the OPERATIONS role (active/published data).

item.name: Notifications
item.description: Real-time (SSE) notifications: stream, read state, admin broadcast.

request.description: Server-Sent Events stream. Auth via ?token=<accessToken> query param (EventSource cannot set headers). Open in a browser or SSE client.

item.name: Role Requests
item.description: Users request extra roles; ADMIN approves/rejects.
